prompt: A pencil sketch with light color wash depicts a busy construction site. On the left, a worker in a yellow hard hat stands firmly on a steel beam. In the center, a foreman wearing blue overalls points toward a stack of bricks. Next to the bricks, a stray cat with orange fur sits quietly observing the scene. To the right, an engineer in a white shirt looks at a clipboard held by an assistant in green gloves. The assistant is handing a rolled blueprint to the engineer. The worker in the yellow hard hat is looking at the foreman. There is no heavy machinery visible in the background. The sketch captures the raw energy of the site through loose lines and subtle watercolor tints, focusing entirely on the human and animal elements present. The composition balances the verticality of the standing figures with the horizontal line of the beam, creating a dynamic yet structured visual narrative without unnecessary clutter or mechanical distractions.
